summary: Radar for 2026-10-17, GLP-1 focus. Four fresh, checked hooks lead: (1) the EU advisory committee (CHMP) recommended Lilly's Foundayo (orforglipron) pill on Oct 16, with the European Commission decision pending in about 2 months; (2) the UK regulator (MHRA) seized about 12,000 fake retatrutide and tirzepatide pens worth about £2M on Oct 14; (3) a SURPASS-CVOT exploratory analysis in heart failure: tirzepatide 18.2% vs dulaglutide 21.5% for death or a heart-failure event; (4) a Penn AI study of Reddit posts on unregulated retatrutide, where increased appetite was the most-reported symptom. Noise: the 'first generic GLP-1' (Teva) is old news from Aug 2025, Teva's Weltruza is a schizophrenia drug, Novo's 2027 price cut was announced in Feb 2026, and Walmart's free GLP-1s are for type 2 diabetes only. The orforglipron-in-Europe question fits our Instagram status-question format; the heart-failure result and the fake pens fit our YouTube Short formats. Retatrutide numbers must be fact-checked: earlier coverage gave both 18.8% and 20.8% for TRIUMPH-2. Scare topics, dosing-strategy items and compounded-switching items are rejected or deprioritised.

candidates.topic: Is the orforglipron pill (Foundayo) approved in Europe yet? CHMP recommended it on Oct 16, 2026; European Commission decision pending
candidates.angle: Dated status question for Instagram: 'recommended' is not 'approved'. Explain what CHMP is, that the Commission usually decides within about 2 months, that it would be the EU's second GLP-1 pill after the Wegovy pill (EU-approved in July for weight only), and that Lilly reported up to about 11% weight loss in the obesity trials. Add the prescriber line.
candidates.predicted_peak: 3-10 days (and again at the Commission decision, around mid-December)
candidates.why_now: The CHMP opinion came out Oct 16. CNBC, Bloomberg, Endpoints and PharmExec covered it within hours. Health-creator coverage is still thin, and our dated status question was our best GLP-1 Reel (84 reach).

evidence.signal: The EU regulator recommended Foundayo; it would be the second GLP-1 pill in the bloc

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) vs dulaglutide (Trulicity) in heart failure: SURPASS-CVOT exploratory analysis, 18.2% vs 21.5% death or heart-failure event
candidates.angle: Head-to-head naming both drugs, generic first. Population: type 2 diabetes with heart disease and a history of heart failure, about 4 years. 'Exploratory analysis' and 'linked to' wording. Give the answer by about 10 s. Mention common stomach side effects briefly.
candidates.why_now: AJMC reported it Oct 15 (Eur J Prev Cardiol). FDA approved tirzepatide in Aug 2026 to lower major heart-event risk in high-risk type 2 diabetes. Named head-to-heads are our strongest Short format (SURMOUNT-5: 147 views).

evidence.signal: Composite occurred in 18.2% on tirzepatide vs 21.5% on dulaglutide among people with heart failure (13,299 trial participants overall)

evidence.source: J Clin Endocrinol Metab meta-analysis, Oct 13
evidence.signal: Tirzepatide effects on heart and kidney markers and exercise capacity in heart failure

candidates.topic: Unregulated 'retatrutide': a Penn AI study of 13,589 Reddit users found increased appetite was the most-reported symptom, unlike the trial
candidates.angle: What's confirmed vs not: the Phase 2 trial mostly reported stomach side effects; self-reports about unverified products mostly described increased appetite, fatigue (15.2%), insomnia and a faster heart rate. Possible reason: you can't know what's in the vial. These are self-reports with no lab checks. Point to prescribers and approved options.
candidates.why_now: EurekAlert (Oct 15) and Medscape covered it, and a Health and Me piece ran on '129 symptoms'. Retatrutide searches are high after TRIUMPH-2. Our 'research peptide isn't the trial drug' idea fits.

evidence.signal: AI used to surface unreported GLP-1 side effects in Reddit posts
